definitions.explanation: The process by which plants, crops, or other living organisms grow and develop. Primarily used in agricultural and biological contexts rather than for human growth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生育|せいいく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{日当|ひあ}たり→日当たり：07498_hiatari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{生育|せいいく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒冷|かんれい}→寒冷：19667_kanrei⟧な⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{生育|せいいく}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This variety can grow even in cold climates.

notes:
Primarily used for the growth and development of plants, crops, and other organisms. While it can occasionally apply to human growth, ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧ and ⟦{発育|はついく}→発育：25326_hatsuiku⟧ are far more common for people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生育|せいいく}⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: growing environment
- {生育|せいいく}⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧: growth conditions
- {生育|せいいく}⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧: growth status
- {生育|せいいく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: growing period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧: growth — the most general term; used for people, businesses, economies, and plants
- ⟦{発育|はついく}→発育：25326_hatsuiku⟧: physical development — mainly used for human physical growth, especially of children
- ⟦{生長|せいちょう}→生長：00455_seichou⟧: growth (of plants) — close synonym sometimes used interchangeably with {生育|せいいく}
